status: Exploratory only; neither spatial-mean detector nor persistent soft-response state is included in retained C7.

spatial_mean.method: Compare3x3 current/raw-history luma means using relative difference; reference point criterion uses current3x3 YCoCg AABB clipped history. Baseline colors, common masks, existing16-read geometry protection. No feedback simulation.
spatial_mean.conclusion: Moderate discrimination, not a clean separation. Combined point+mean retains about54-58% of tent static candidates and79-82% of forward candidates. At the known wall-shadow alias, mean still follows the same jitter signal. Lower0.14 continuation threshold separates less well.

persistent_soft.method: Seed actual C7 soft events; extend on stable grid while same signed dominant color direction remains above half-entry thresholds. Fixed C7 colors; no closed-loop simulation.
persistent_soft.conclusion: Forward continuation opportunities increase, but static active rate rises about3.6x/2.6x and some static candidates stay active through48 captured frames. Extra feedback could shorten them, but current data does not establish safety. Not adopted.

limits: Classification/continuation opportunities only; no prediction of final noise or response. Nominal luma/chroma thresholds used; unavailable reprojection-boundary scaling omitted.
